sloka: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहः कृपां मयि नरर्षभ ।त्वया नाथवती नाथ ह्यनाथा इव दृश्यते ।। ५.३८.४०।।।।
transliteration: sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaḥ kṛpāṁ mayi nararṣabha ।tvayā nāthavatī nātha hyanāthā iva dṛśyate ।। 5.38.40।।।।

translations.english: 'O bull among men you are so loving to me. I am like an orphan. Be kind to me. She who has found her lord in you stays without a protector.
